rows.itemTitle: RENEWAL TERMINATION TRANSFER AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION
rows.summary: Item 17 adds a new Restaurant Brand Amendment package, broadens termination grounds (including an added non-curable Existing Agreements breach), tightens spa and restaurant transfer restrictions, removes a pre-opening permitted-transfer fee waiver, adds a managed-to-franchised conversion lender comfort letter obligation, extends the during-term non-compete to management companies, and rewrites the FA assignment and integration clauses.
